Forms

Switch

On/off switch (role=switch). A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-switch.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Toggle switch for on/off preferences (notifications, filters).

<Switch label="Receber novidades por e-mail" checked={v} onChange={e=>setV(e.target.checked)} />

The native checkbox behind the track is visually hidden but still focusable and announced (role="switch"); clicking the label toggles it and :focus-visible draws the ring on the track. Always pass label — an unlabelled switch has nothing to announce.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
labelReact.ReactNode—

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type'>, a ref and className.

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Switch without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-choice-box-bg{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-choice-box-border{rse.color.border-strong}#84806f#7a7890#000000
--rse-choice-checked{rse.color.primary}#6c62c4#8e82d8#4a3fa8
--rse-choice-label{rse.color.text-body}#454235#cfcdc6#1a1926
--rse-choice-thumb{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-choice-track{rse.color.border-strong}#84806f#7a7890#000000
